inv.location: Puerta Blanca - Almudena, Carretera de Cádiz, Málaga
inv.desc_es:
TRASPASAMOS LOCAL EN PLENO FUNCIONAMIENTO!

Fantástica Oportunidad de inversión en excelente Restaurante en pleno funcionamiento. Situado en la zona de Moliere, a un paso del Paseo Marítimo. La tapería se encuentra equipada de todo lo necesario para continuar con el negocio. Aire Acondicionado. Frigoríficos. Cocina. Doce metros de Fachada. Cristaleras de Lumon. Terraza de más de 70 metros cuadrados con techos abatibles. Cristaleras Magníficos ingresos demostrables.

Situado en una zona con todos los servicios: colegios, comercios, transporte público (metro justo al lado y autobuses) y a pocos minutos de la playa.

No pierdas esta oportunidad de vivir en una de las mejores zonas de Málaga. ¡Contáctanos para concertar una visita! No dude en llamarnos y visite la vivienda con Inmobiliarias BLANHOGAR, una de las Agencias Malagueñas con una trayectoria excelente desde el año 2.000, un trato familiar y con todos los servicios que usted necesita para acceder a la compra de su hogar. Nos encontramos en Avenida Velázquez, 60 (junto a la Volkswagen) en horario de mañana y tarde (de 9:30h a 14h y de 17h a 20:30h). Además los sábados de 10:00 a 13:30, nuestros Agentes les atenderán en horario de mañanas.

We specialize in selling apartments, studios, and residential properties in the beautiful city of Málaga, Spain. Whether you are looking for a holiday home, an investment opportunity, or a permanent residence, we are here to help. Our experienced team provides personalized assistance to international buyers, making the entire purchasing process simple, secure, and stress-free. Discover your ideal property in Málaga with us.
******************************************************************************************************************************************************************
Transparencia y normativa vigente:

Este anuncio cumple con la Ley 10/2025, de servicios de atención a la clientela, garantizando información clara, veraz y accesible sobre el inmueble y sus condiciones.

Asimismo, en cumplimiento del Decreto 218/2005 de la Junta de Andalucía, informamos de que los gastos notariales, registrales, ITP, gastos financieros y demás costes inherentes a la compraventa no están incluidos en el precio. Honorarios de la intermediación no incluidos (5.000 € mas IVA).
inv.desc_en:
BUSINESS FOR TRANSFER, FULLY OPERATIONAL!

Fantastic investment opportunity in an excellent, fully operational restaurant. Located in the Moliere area, just a step away from the Promenade. The tapas bar is equipped with everything necessary to continue the business. Air conditioning. Refrigerators. Kitchen. Twelve-meter facade. Lumon glass enclosures. Terrace of over 70 square meters with retractable roofs. Magnificent, demonstrable income.

Located in an area with all services: schools, shops, public transport (metro right next door and buses), and just a few minutes from the beach.

Do not miss this opportunity to live in one of the best areas of Malaga. Contact us to arrange a visit! Do not hesitate to call us and visit the property with Inmobiliarias BLANHOGAR, one of the Malaga agencies with an excellent track record since the year 2000, offering a familiar approach and all the services you need to access the purchase of your home. We are located at Avenida Velázquez, 60 (next to Volkswagen) with morning and afternoon hours (from 9:30 AM to 2:00 PM and from 5:00 PM to 8:30 PM). Additionally, on Saturdays from 10:00 AM to 1:30 PM, our agents will assist you in the morning.

We specialize in selling apartments, studios, and residential properties in the beautiful city of Málaga, Spain. Whether you are looking for a holiday home, an investment opportunity, or a permanent residence, we are here to help. Our experienced team provides personalized assistance to international buyers, making the entire purchasing process simple, secure, and stress-free. Discover your ideal property in Málaga with us.
******************************************************************************************************************************************************************
Transparency and current regulations:

This advertisement complies with Law 10/2025 on customer service, guaranteeing clear, truthful, and accessible information about the property and its conditions.

Likewise, in compliance with Decree 218/2005 of the Regional Government of Andalusia, we inform you that notary fees, registration fees, ITP (Property Transfer Tax), financial expenses, and other costs inherent to the sale are not included in the price. Intermediation fees are not included (€5,000 plus VAT).
